title: Paperclip-ing ticket contract v2 (the single join node: task + agent + lessons + PMO)
description: The frozen ticket seam between the fleet's claim ledger (governance/dispatch/) and the upstream issue surface, and the SINGLE JOIN NODE for tasks, agents, the lessons register and the PMO (ADR-0014, issues #370/#400). Contract v2 is ADDITIVE: the v1 keys (id, owner, status, blocked_by, goal, evidence) keep their meaning and a v1 document still validates. v2 adds kind (the generic improvement register is a ticket kind), facets (a CLOSED set: lessons, raid, budget) and authority{} (one writer per field — the ticket is a projection, never authority; ADR-0014). See docs/PAPERCLIP-ING-INTEGRATION.md.

id.description: Ticket identifier (fleet: the issue number as kushin77/agent-orchestrator#N).

owner.description: The single accountable agent that owns this ticket — never a set.

status.description: Ticket lifecycle state. done is a verdict, not a self-report.

blocked_by.description: Explicit blocked-by relations: the ticket ids this ticket waits on (empty when unblocked).

goal.description: Goal / milestone reference this ticket serves (fleet: the epic, e.g. EPIC-00 = issue #4).

evidence.description: Evidence references backing the status. v1 accepted a bare string; v2 also admits a structured receipt, so the same receipt that proves delivery also backs the budget charge (seam-doc mismatches #6 and #10). Additive: both forms validate.

kind.description: Ticket kind. The generic improvement register is a ticket kind, which is how an open SUGGEST-* becomes an addressable node (ADR-0014).

facets.description: Facet groups the ticket joins on. A CLOSED set — an unknown facet fails, so a new facet is a contract change (ADR-0014).

authority.description: One writer per field. Each entry maps a populated field to its SINGLE producing lane; a field with two writers fails and a populated field with no entry fails (ADR-0014). The ticket is a projection, never authority: the named lane is the source, the ticket is rebuildable.

evidence_receipt.description: A structured evidence receipt: the receipt that proves delivery and backs the budget charge are the same object (ADR-0014).

ref.description: Receipt id — for a gate run, the attestation git_sha.

checks.description: The number of checks the receipt covers.

facet_lessons.description: The lessons facet: the incident a lesson came from, its RCA, its corrective actions and its solution class.

incident.description: The incident this lesson came from (INC-*).

facet_raid.description: The RAID facet: the risk a ticket carries and its remediation. authority facets.raid = derived — computed from the ticket's risk signals, not written by a lane.

risk.description: The risk level carried by this ticket.

remediation.description: The ticket id that remediates the risk.

facet_budget.description: The budget facet: the spend this ticket caused, against a cap, with the per-task receipt. authority facets.budget = telemetry/budgets.

scope.description: What the spend is scoped to (mirrors budget.schema.json scope).

spent.description: The spend this ticket caused in the period.

cap.description: The cap the spend is measured against.

receipt.description: The ledger entry backing the spend — the same receipt id an evidence[] receipt carries (mismatch #10).
